_about: Target universe for ATLAS. Sources: hand-researched rows (company sites, trade press), the IWDC co-op member directory (2026 public directory; 2014 PDF for historical members), EIGA and national association lists, and targeted web research for Europe, Nordics, Middle East & Africa, Latin America and Asia Pacific. Every row cites its source. status: target = independent; sponsor = private-equity owned (secondary-buyout candidate); consolidator = independent buyer/roll-up; consolidated = owned by a major or roll-up; major = Tier-1 producer; demo = local safety-test site. Ownership and branch counts are verified at run time by the Scout.

market_notes_canada.fact: The public IWDC directory lists only about 10 Canadian HQ members (Alberta Welding Supplies, CamCarb, Core Industrial Gases, Innovair, Lock 8, Oxygen Products Calgary, Oxygène Bois-Francs, Ron-Son's, Simcoe Gases, Western Canada Welding Products, Western Gasco) plus AMECO branches.
Meritus Gas Partners lists only US partners and locations (West, Southwest, Midwest, Southeast); no Canadian presence is shown.
Linde acquired Ontario's Dry Ice & Gases Co.; customer pickups moved to Linde Brampton from May 1, 2026.

Many Canadian independents are authorized dealers of a major (e.g., Western Gasco, Triton, KCM, Island Oxygen and Nova Industrial with Air Liquide; Lamarre with Linde), so gas supply contracts and change-of-control terms are a key diligence item.
Several Quebec 'Oxygène [town]' dealers share an address or website with a Praxair/Linde listing, which suggests a Linde dealer network; check independence before approaching.
Innovair (Welders Supplies, est. 1946) calls itself Canada's largest independent producer and supplier of industrial and medical gases. It is a natural platform candidate.
Tenaquip (family-owned national MRO distributor) acquired Northern Industrial Sales in 2016.

No PE-backed or roll-up-owned Canadian gas distributor could be confirmed from the pages fetched. Web search was unavailable (budget exhausted), so there was no gasworld/MDM news sweep; sponsor_owned is empty pending that check.
